items.a: 天气很冷，但是孩子们还在外面玩。
items.m: Although it's cold, the children are still playing outside.
Although this dish is tasty, it's too expensive.

items.a: 下雨了，所以我们没有出去。
items.m: Because it was raining, we didn't go out.
Because he's ill, he didn't come to class today.

items.a: 学了两年汉语，但是说得不太好。
items.m: Although I've studied Chinese for two years, I don't speak it very well.
Although she's only twenty, she's already a doctor.
Although he's tired, he's still working.
Because I have an exam tomorrow, I'm not watching TV today.

r: 虽然已经很晚了，但是他还在工作。
items.m: Although it's already very late, he's still working.

items.m: Although my older brother is tall, I'm not.

r: 虽然外面很冷，但是房间里很热。
